t: A small RISC-V computer kit with 60 TOPS of AI and fast networking.
steps: Look for the kit at Arace or JD, and check stock first. Sipeed and Banana Pi sell the same board.
Get a USB-C PD charger rated for up to 65 W.
Connect a monitor through USB-C DisplayPort, plus a keyboard and mouse.
Check the Milk-V Jupiter2 docs overview for the latest OS images.
Boot Bianbu or Ubuntu 26.04 and connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Open a terminal and run a small Python script.
Try SpacemiT's ONNX Runtime with a small sample model.
